notes.title: "The Awakener:Forgotten Oath" Version 2.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Awakeners,
The upcoming Version 2.4 update focuses on improving performance and reducing stuttering, especially during early gameplay interactions. Our goal is to provide a smoother and more immersive combat experience for all players.

Update Highlights:
1.New Precompilation Phase in Main Menu
The game now precompiles essential resources such as skill animations and effects during the main menu phase, reducing load time during actual combat.

2.Reduced Stutter on First Hit
Addressed issues where the first time a character’s skill hits an enemy would cause a noticeable stutter. Combat feedback is now more responsive.

3.Optimized First-Time Visual Effect Loads
Improved how visual effects are loaded the first time they appear, such as potion use or spell casting, reducing the delay and enhancing immersion.

4.Improved Initial Level Loading Performance
Reduced stuttering and load times when entering a map or level for the first time.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Feel free to share your thoughts with us on the community channels!

notes.title: V2.1 Updates
notes.content:
Added achievement system.
Adjusted Artefacts CD to Artefacts Charging.
Added Artefacts Charging bar below Artefact Slot position.
Artefacts will be charged when using Normal Attacks, Battle Skills, Dash Skills.
Removed the privious UI display of Artefacts CD and charging points.
Added customized skills selection in the The Animitta and Training Ground.
Customized skills could be taken into challenges.
Upgraded all Normal Attacks, Battle Skills and Dash Skills by one level, each of them will be four levels.
Modified enchanting of all Normal Attacks, Battle Skills and Dash Skills to adjust the attack power.
Polished the action card description.
Lowered item prices to 100/200/400.
Lowered the selling price of skills to 80.
Moved "Weapon selection" to "Weapon Appearance", including the small text in the interface instead of "Weapon Select".
Increased the basic attack value of Normal Attacks, Battle Skills and Dash Skills.
Modified the basic values Normal Attacks, Battle Skills and Dash Skills to balance the game.
Added swaps artifact slots in the pause menu.
After boss battles,you will not only obtain HP potions by the goddness statues that have already been consumed, but also recover 30% HP.
Entering the first level of the challenges you will get an additional Artefacts selection.
Adjusted the gems color of trap statue in Chapter 1.
Introduced key binding.
Deleted the artifact that increases the action speed.
Modified the way holy relics charge Artefacts.
Modified the rule that items refreshing in the shops.
Some monsters add the Warning line for attacks.
Modify the transition attacks of the third boss.

notes.title: Ver 1.01 Updates
notes.content:
1. Introduced camera X-Axis and Y-Axis Invert function.
2. Resolution can be adjusted in full screen.
3. Adjusted game difficulty.
4. Fixed the bug in calculating the number of game clearance incorrectly.
5. Reduced the requirements to unlock world difficulty levels.
6. Optimized character ground movement decisions by the in-game system.

notes.title: The Awakener: Forgotten Oath Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello Awakeners,

We've received a wealth of feedback and suggestions since the game's launch. Thanks to all of you, we're committed to continually improving the game.

Updates include:
1. Added full-screen resolution support
2. Introduced Controller Invert function
3. Adjusted game difficulty
4. Reduced the requirements to unlock world difficulty levels
5. Optimized character ground movement decisions by the in-game system

Additionally, we plan to keep updating the game in the future. The launch is just the beginning for a small team like TANER GAMES. Time constraints and other factors mean we must carefully plan our updates. We will release a detailed plan about future updates, including new careers and characters.

Thank you for your support!
